title: Compute-rendered Bézier ribbons (Vello)
description: Vello renders original Bézier paths through the local Metal compute backend. Compare three actual stroke-width renders; these are saved GPU outputs.

prompt: Compute-rendered Bézier ribbons. Edit the supplied Rust source and rerun the recipe to change computation inputs.
